resources.limitation: One measured startup CPU violation. Chrome child sandbox jobs reject reassignment: all owned QA processes then used shared affinity plus aggregate sampling; no global/user process changes.

limitations: No full Foundry server restart; client F5 verified for both roles.
Half HP/ST below 1 or outside safe integer range has no supported thrust entry: additional Overrun damage is explicitly manual.
B431 table and alternative formula differ at 100 yards (47 vs 46); requested rounded formula is used consistently.
Initial before screenshot contains a Foundry viewport warning; final screenshots use 1300×1100 with no warning.
PLAYER checks require no Actor or token; Actor OWNER permissions are not used by this tool.
